summary: Backend 12/12 pytest tests passed: categories (7), expenses CRUD (create/list/update/delete/404/date-filter), budget upsert+validation, week summary structure+over_limit logic, and /api/suggestions returns LLM-powered 3 suggestions (Claude Sonnet 4.6 via Emergent key). Frontend mobile flows all worked end-to-end: Home weekly total card + FAB, Add Expense (amount + category chip + note + submit), Stats (daily bars + category breakdown), Coach (3 AI suggestions + refresh), Settings (weekly limit + currency persisted with saved toast), and over-limit danger banner (rendered '₹5.50' with INR symbol after switching currency) with working dismissal that persists across reload via async storage. After tests, expense was deleted and budget reset to {weekly_limit:0, currency:USD} so a fresh user sees the empty state. No _id leakage in any API response. No mocked APIs. No deprecated Expo packages.

react_native_issues.issue: tabBarTestID on Tabs.Screen (frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx) does not propagate to a data-testid attribute on react-native-web. Selecting tabs via [data-testid="tab-home"] etc. fails; selecting by visible text works. Cosmetic for tests only — does not affect users. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx

Console warning: "shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow". Emitted from totalCard / fab / tabBarStyle. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents (likely from a library, low priority)

action_items: (Optional) Wrap each Tabs.Screen with a custom tabBarButton that forwards a data-testid, or use accessibilityLabel selectors in future tests — tabBarTestID is not honored by react-native-web.
(Optional) Migrate shadow* styles to boxShadow to silence RN 0.81 deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly excludes Mongo _id via projection {"_id":0} and explicit serialize_expense.
Budget endpoint stores doc with _id:'global' singleton — clean upsert pattern.
Suggestions endpoint has robust try/except + JSON-extraction + sensible fallback; will never 500.
Frontend api.ts uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and /api prefix as required.
All interactive elements have testID attributes except React Navigation tab buttons (tabBarTestID limitation on web).
seed_data_creation: No seed data left behind. The single test expense ($25.50 Food TEST_team_lunch) created during UI testing was deleted; budget reset to weekly_limit=0, currency=USD. Fresh user sees the empty state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints and frontend flows are working as specified. /api/suggestions takes ~5-10s due to LLM call — give it ample timeout. tabBarTestID isn't honored on react-native-web; select tabs by visible label text. Banner dismissal stores per-week+level key in AsyncStorage so dismissed banners stay hidden across reload but reappear next week.
rca_of_issue: N/A — first iteration, no failing items to root-cause.
